question: Which US diplomatic posts are at elevated physical-security risk over the next 30 days, ranked by composite threat score derived from recent (90-day) political-violence event proximity, severity, US-actor involvement, and trend direction?

matches.project: Embassy Threat Monitor v2 (child of Prep Agent)
matches.note: This IS the DS the current flow publishes. A refresh over the same spec is the intended pass.

matches.project: Embassy Threat Monitor v2 (child of Prep Agent)

matches.note: Filtered GDELT feed already on-site; upstream of the two above.

internal_scan.verdict: This question already has canonical internal DSes on-site. The advanced route's job on this pass is to (a) verify the SAT indicators are still covered by the current spec, (b) surface any indicator drift, and (c) refresh with the same spec.json handoff — not to re-acquire the upstream.

indicators.name: Count of qualifying events within 50mi of post
data_required: Post roster with lat/lon (60 US posts)
GDELT event records with ActionGeo_Lat/Long, SQLDATE, EventRootCode

candidates.result: GREEN — carries per-event columns feeding this indicator
FALLBACK — used by the current spec's api_caller

indicators.acceptance: ≥50 posts with non-null lat/lon; events feed has ≥1000 qualifying rows in the last 90d

indicators.name: Min haversine distance of any qualifying event to each post
data_required: Per-event lat/lon; roster lat/lon; distance calc

candidates.source: computed in embassy_threat_join transformation using haversine helper

indicators.name: Max CAMEO root code observed within radius per post
Weighted incident score (severity × recency-decay × mentions-weight)

candidates.source: embassy_threat_join scoring layer — CAMEO-severity × exp(-days/half_life) × log(mentions)

indicators.acceptance: F1.1 met; NumMentions non-null on ≥90% of events

indicators.name: Named top-severity event summary + source URL per post
data_required: Actor1Name, Actor2Name, ActionGeo_FullName, EventCode → human verb, SOURCEURL

candidates.source: embassy_threat_join composes event_summary; embassy_risk_summary picks top-severity per post
candidates.result: GREEN — this is the v2 addition over v1

indicators.acceptance: Actor1Name populated on ≥70% of qualifying rows

indicators.name: Share of qualifying events with Actor1/2 country = USA
indicators.acceptance: F1.1 met; actor country codes present on ≥95% of rows

candidates.result: AMBER — computable but not currently surfaced on the Summary DS as a distinct column; folded into weighted_threat_score's recency-decay term

indicators.name: 5-band risk classification per post
indicators.acceptance: F2.2 met; every post assigned a band

indicators.name: Distinct source-URL count per event (deduplication check)

candidates.source: SOURCEURL column carried through to Events DS; NumMentions used as the URL-inflation proxy
candidates.result: AMBER — GDELT 1.0 emits one row per source URL and does not carry a distinct-event key. Downstream deduplication is heuristic (SQLDATE + ActionGeo_Lat/Long + EventCode).

preference_order_rule: INTERNAL (already-published DS) → INTERNAL (upstream feed DS) → DERIVED → EXTERNAL. Internal-first is trivially satisfied — the answering DSes already exist.
approval_required_before_acquisition: None — refresh runs against data.gdeltproject.org, already an approved host on this site.
gap_summary: F4.1 is AMBER: WoW trend delta is folded into weighted_threat_score's decay term rather than surfaced as its own column. A v3 could split it out.
F5.1 is AMBER: GDELT 1.0's URL-per-row shape means distinct-event dedup is heuristic. Switching to GDELT 2.0 (which carries GKGRECORDID) would upgrade this to GREEN but changes the upstream contract.
